answer: Stop sybils with a social-recovery guardian quorum. First, each new identity names five unrelated guardians who each stake 100 POA and confirm the applicant is real and known to them. Second, the identity activates only when at least four guardians sign; a proven fake costs each guardian their stake. Third, guardians rotate yearly, so a farm cannot rent the same five forever. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 50,000 guardians at $80 each, $4,000,000, plus 5,000,000 POA locked. Like an onyx lantern in a dark pass, five lights guide one traveler; at its nadir, a fake finds no hand to hold.
